video_title: Bennett Stirtz Had ZERO D1 Offers… Then Became an NBA First-Round Pick | 16th Pick | EP3

quotes.speaker: Roger Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Roger Stirtz on Bennett Stirtz's understanding of what it takes to win
quotes.excerpt: he understood what it took to win and he was probably a player that understood that more
quotes.quote: He always understood the moment. He understood what it took to win and he was probably a player that understood that more than any player I've ever had before and seen because even at a young age, he knew what needed to be done and how it needed to be done in order to win. And he had the ability to do that and make his teammates better.

quotes.speaker: Caden Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Caden Stirtz on Bennett Stirtz's humility despite his rise in basketball
quotes.excerpt: if you approach him, he's as approachable as as you can get and he's still extremely humble
quotes.quote: If you approach him, he's as approachable as you can get and he's still extremely humble about his faith, his family, his friends. Those people are always going to be more important to him than the fame, and I think that that says a lot about him.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on his lack of confidence during his Division 2 career
quotes.excerpt: I was still lacking my confidence in Division 2, so I could shoot the ball like in practice
quotes.quote: I was still lacking my confidence in Division 2, so I could shoot the ball like in practice, but when games are going, my confidence, I was scared to be out there. I was still a decent player, but I haven't unleashed my full potential.

quotes.speaker: Renee Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Renee Stirtz on the importance of servant leadership and faith for Bennett
quotes.excerpt: make sure that the Lord is your confidant, your strength and your peace
quotes.quote: The lessons we really strived to impart to the kids is that be true to who you are and make sure that the Lord is your confidant, your strength and your peace and just to make sure that you invest in people around you that you're a servant first and that your talents were given to you as a precious commodity and to use those to make the people around you better.

quotes.speaker: Ben McCollum
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben McCollum on Bennett Stirtz's readiness for the professional level
quotes.excerpt: I think he's ready to play. So wherever he gets drafted, he's ready to go.
quotes.quote: I think it's probably a unique experience just because there's a lot surrounding it. I think he's ready to play. So wherever he gets drafted, he's ready to go. I think some people get really excited about just hearing your name called and he'll be excited because he's earned that right and opportunity, but more importantly, the second it gets called, he's going to want to go to work and that's probably his focus right now.

quotes.speaker: Bennett Stirtz
quotes.summary_phrase: Bennett Stirtz on building relationships and fitting in with an NBA team
quotes.excerpt: I think it starts with creating relationships and knowing what the team needs out of me
quotes.quote: I think it starts with creating relationships and knowing what the team needs out of me. So making it clear, talking to Coach Daigneault, talking to Sam and seeing what they want from me and just being myself out there because I'm pretty versatile and I can do whatever they need me to do.
